title: Cups, Plates, and More Than One
label: ch:ar-cups-plates-and-more-than-one
canDo: I can ask for oil, a cup, a plate and a spoon in Arabic, and I can tell a broken plural from a sound one and say which kind of noun usually takes which.

payoff.summary: Set the mi- tool shape of milʿaqa and mirʾāh against the ma- place shape of maṭʿam and maktab, then sort the plurals: akwāb, aṭbāq and malāʿiq re-poured into a new shape against qahawāt and ṣadīqāt, which only add an ending — and ask for each thing with min faḍlik.
